description.zh:
指定要查询的控制策略所在堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to get this ID.

description.zh:
指定要查询的控制策略ID。
> 您可以调用[ListPolicies ](~~2758876~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the control policy that you want to query.

> You can call the [ListPolicies](~~2758876~~) operation to get this ID.

description.zh:
指定要查询的控制策略所在堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host instance.

> For more information about region IDs, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 获取指定控制策略详情

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-policy --instance-id bastionhost-cn-zvp2d3syb0g --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 3 --region cn-hangzhou
